name: evidence_create
title: Create evidence workbook
description: Generates a work-evidence xlsx with screenshots pasted in, from an EvidenceSpec JSON. Places the images listed in the spec in order and adds annotations. Before generating, it checks the title, captions and annotations against the text rules and generates nothing if there is a violation.

input_path.description: Absolute path of the EvidenceSpec JSON. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

out_path.description: Absolute path of the xlsx to write. If omitted, evidence.xlsx in the same directory as input_path. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

event.description: result on success, evidence.create.error on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

outPath.description: Absolute path of the written xlsx (success only)

path.description: Path of the image as written in the spec

skipped.description: Images that were skipped (success only; empty when none)

violations.description: Text rule violations (failure only, kind text-violation)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted
